scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: You did not ask diagnostic probing questions about video streaming quality, network connection type, or app cache status.

grader.scenario: S-Net TV Go mobile app giving Error 409 'Maximum Registered Devices Reached'

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net digital TV technical support' and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' properly stated.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced and thanked properly with no unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and 4-digit security PIN within 41 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Addressed customer naturally as Callum throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: When customer expressed frustration at [06:09] about missing the kickoff of a Champions League match, Agent acknowledged at [06:34]: 'I completely understand how frustrating it is to miss kickoff when you are looking forward to watching your team in the Champions League, Callum.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [02:53]: 'So if I have all the details correctly, Callum, your TV Go app on your iPad Air is throwing Error 409 because your account has hit the maximum limit of five registered streaming devices, and because the customer portal is down for maintenance, you need us to wipe the stale devices from our system, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Agent did not repeat questions and legitimately confirmed the primary streaming tablet model at [07:08] before deleting obsolete licenses.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent performed the selective DRM token revocation directly on the media gateway.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Agent maintained an exceptionally warm, professional, and supportive manner throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked no diagnostic probing questions regarding Wi-Fi throughput, app storage cache, or video buffer settings.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer force-closed the app, relaunched, and verified live HD playback of TNT Sports 1 at [10:45].
